title: Trace Koszul resolution for a surjective etale scheme cover
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ with its small etale site [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:U\to X$ be a representable surjective etale morphism from a scheme [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $E$ be the free abelian sheaf on $U/X$: the sheafification of the presheaf $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{a\in\operatorname{Hom}_X(V,U)}\mathbf Z e_a$ on etale scheme objects $V\to X$, with restriction $e_a\mapsto e_{a|_{V\prime}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let $\epsilon:E\to\underline{\mathbf Z}$ send each $e_a$ to $1$. Write $\bigwedge^nE$ for the sheafification of sectionwise exterior powers over $\underline{\mathbf Z}$, with exterior powers as in [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra] and tensor as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For $p\geq0$ set $K_p=\bigwedge^{p+1}E$. The contraction formula $$\partial_p(e_0\wedge\cdots\wedge e_p)=\sum_{i=0}^p(-1)^i\epsilon(e_i)e_0\wedge\cdots\wedge\widehat{e_i}\wedge\cdots\wedge e_p$$ defines maps $\partial_p:K_p\to K_{p-1}$ for $p\geq1$ and $\partial_0=\epsilon:K_0\to\underline{\mathbf Z}$. The augmented sequence $$\cdots\longrightarrow K_2\longrightarrow K_1\longrightarrow K_0\xrightarrow{\epsilon}\underline{\mathbf Z}\longrightarrow0$$ is a chain complex exact at every term in the abelian category of abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. No separation or finiteness of the fibres of $f$ is assumed.

proof.text: Put $R=\underline{\mathbf Z}$. The unit $\eta:\mathbf Z\to R$ from the constant presheaf is inverted by sheafification; on underlying sets $|\eta|$ is a set sheafification by [lem-pc-sites-sheafification-underlying-sets], so $|\eta|$ is locally bijective by [lem-weil-pbc-large-set-sheafification]. In particular every section of $R(V)$ is, on some covering of $V$, the image of an integer. On each site object $V$, regard $E(V)$ as an $R(V)$-module: a section of $R(V)$ acts, on a covering where it is the image of an integer $n$, by multiplication by $n$; by local injectivity of $|\eta|$ these local products agree on overlaps after refinement, and the sheaf axiom of $E$ glues them uniquely. The same argument makes $\epsilon_V:E(V)\to R(V)$ linear. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-koszul-differential-existence] with this commutative ring, module and linear form. Its recurrence, starting with $D(1)=0$, gives exactly the displayed contraction formula on every pure wedge. Such wedges span each exterior power by [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra], so the formula determines $D$, lowers exterior degree by one, and commutes with restriction: restricting each summand gives the identical formula on the restricted wedge. Thus $P_p(V)=\bigwedge^{p+1}_{R(V)}E(V)$, $P_{-1}(V)=R(V)$ and their contractions form an augmented diagram of presheaves of abelian groups. Sheafifying its arrows gives the stated maps on $K_p=P_p^\#$ by [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]; $P_0=E$ and $P_{-1}=R$ are already sheaves.

source.place: Tag 0622, definition-koszul and the explicit formula immediately following it; spaces-cohomology.tex Tag 0723, preceding construction

proof.text: The augmented presheaf diagram is a complex. On a pure wedge, the two terms of $D^2$ deleting positions $i<j$ have coefficients $(-1)^{i+j-1}\epsilon(e_i)\epsilon(e_j)$ and $(-1)^{i+j}\epsilon(e_j)\epsilon(e_i)$; the remaining factors occur in the same order. They cancel because $R(V)$ is commutative. This includes $\epsilon D=0$ on $\bigwedge^2E(V)$. Linearity and the spanning description of [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra] prove the assertion on all elements. Sheafification carries zero composites to zero composites, so the augmented sequence in the statement is a chain complex.

Fix any scheme object $V\to X$. By [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], $W=V\times_XU$ is a scheme and $W\to V$ is a surjective etale covering. The second projection $a:W\to U$ defines a basis vector in the free abelian presheaf, hence a section $e\in E(W)$ through its sheafification unit. By the definition of $\epsilon$, $\epsilon_W(e)=1$. The same holds for the restrictions of $e$ to every object over $W$. This uses only representability, surjectivity and etaleness of $f$.

source.place: Tag 0723, surjectivity of the trace; spaces.tex Tag 02X2 and spaces-topologies.tex Tag 041F

proof.text: On the sections over $W$ from Step 3 put $h_p(z)=e\wedge z$ for $p\geq0$, and put $h_{-1}(r)=re$. The recurrence in [lem-weil-pbc-koszul-differential-existence] gives $D(e\wedge z)=\epsilon(e)z-e\wedge D(z)=z-e\wedge D(z)$, so $D h_p+h_{p-1}D=\mathrm{id}$ in every degree $p\geq0$. In degree $-1$, $\epsilon h_{-1}(r)=r\epsilon(e)=r$. Consequently every cycle $z$ of the presheaf complex on $V$ becomes a boundary after restriction to $W$: $z|_W=D(h_p(z|_W))$. The same identity in degree $-1$ shows every augmentation section locally lifts. These equalities are direct substitutions in the cited recurrence, including $p=0$, where $D$ means $\epsilon$.

source.place: Tag 0626, lemma-homotopy-koszul-abstract and its one-line proof, with image f=1

proof.text: For every degree $p\geq-1$, let $H_p(P)$ be the homology presheaf. It is computed objectwise by [lem-weil-pbc-site-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact](1), with fixed scalar ring $\mathbf Z$. Step 4 proves that every section of $H_p(P)$ is zero on a cover. The underlying set-presheaf map $|H_p(P)|\to\{*\}$ is therefore locally bijective: it is surjective on every object by its zero section, and any two sections become equal on a common refinement of covers killing them. By [lem-weil-pbc-large-set-sheafification], its set sheafification is an isomorphism. By [lem-pc-sites-sheafification-underlying-sets], the underlying set sheaf of $H_p(P)^\#$ is thus terminal, so this abelian sheaf is zero. Finally [lem-weil-pbc-site-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact](2) gives $H_p(P^\#)\cong H_p(P)^\#=0$. Since $P^\#$ is precisely the augmented complex of the statement, it is exact at every $K_p$ and at $\underline{\mathbf Z}$, as required.

Clause by clause: U : X.EtaleSite with IsEtale plus hf : IsSurjective gives the representable surjective etale scheme cover, with no extra hypotheses. The module E is tied to presheafToSheaf(uliftYoneda U ⋙ free) by an iso fixed on every generator; it exists and is unique because constant-Z sections are locally integers. ε (generators to 1), a (1-wedges to ε(v 0)) and d p (contraction on arbitrary sections, sign (-1)^j zero-based, succAbove deletion) are each uniquely determined; nothing is hollow or arbitrary. The conclusion gives both zero composites, ShortComplex exactness at K_0 and every K_{p+1} as abelian sheaves after toSheaf, and Epi a for exactness at Z. K_p = siteExteriorPower (p+1) over the constant Z ring sheaf. Coefficients in u+1 match the size convention and the large covering sieves; ULift is only a transport. Edge cases (empty X, identity cover, infinitely many sheets, non-separated f, p=0) are covered. Docstrings carry the source/blueprint and proof steps 1-5; only the main theorem is sorry. No duplicate found in project lean/Sheaf or dag/nodes. Not recompiled, per instruction.
